mina: Heads-up — during a customer onboarding call their Java sampleapp mis-assigned embeddings after we hit a fallback path. Rerank scores are correct but mapped to wrong queries.

arlo: Which endpoint + SDK version? Paste the raw request/response (redact content).

mina: Using java-sdk v0.7 sampleapp, endpoint /v1/embeddings/rerank. Outgoing: items [id: r1, r2, r3, r4]. Response capture (merged after fallback): results came back as two chunks and were concatenated: first chunk had r2,r1, third had r3 then r4. Client code mapped by index and r1/r2 swapped.

pat: Did you see auth/401 or a retry marker?

mina: Yes logs show: [WARN] request id=x1 status=401; [INFO] token refresh; [INFO] retry=1 status=200. The runtime merged the original partial reply + retryed chunk by append without stable ordering.

arlo: Other wrinkle: our quantized/low-mem path emits embeddings as base64-encoded fp16 strings in field "embedding_b64" and dim sometimes as a string. Java helper assumed numeric float[] in "vector". That caused a decode exception in one path and a silent fallback in another which further shuffled responses.

pat: Oof. So three contributors: 1) server-side append-merge on retry, 2) schema drift (vector vs embedding_b64), 3) SDK positional mapping.

java-sdk-bot: note: created draft PR #222: "java-embed-helper: normalize results by id + fp16-b64 decode". Includes unit that shuffles server order and asserts id-aligned output.

mina: For a short-term workaround we changed sampleapp to id-index responses: build map by id from resp.results then reconstruct output array respecting original request order. Also added a small validator: check dim==expected, coerce numeric types, and error loudly on missing ids.

arlo: We should also add a cross-SDK conformance test that loads fixtures for: numeric-path.json, quantized-path.json, and merged-retry.json. All SDKs must normalize to the same in-memory shape.

platform-bot: PLATFORM-1428 updated: platform will echo incoming item id in merged replies and add response header X-Embedding-Format with values "float32" or "fp16-b64" in next minor release. ETA: two weeks.

pat: QA note: added a fuzz harness that simulates auth refresh mid-batch, forces quantized routing on some shards, and randomly permutes chunk order. It found the Java helper mapping bug within 50 iterations. I added the harness to sampleapp CI.

mina: Docs: I'll update the onboarding guide with a short checklist: 1) do not assume ordering; always assemble by id, 2) validate dim and numeric types, 3) decode fp16-b64 when necessary, 4) surface clear errors for missing ids. Add a big caution in the sampleapp README: "Do not rely on response order."

arlo: Long-term: platform change + SDKs defensive normalization should prevent future customer confusion. For now, land the java PR and add the conformance fixtures.

qa-bot: nightly/sampleapp-compat run: shuffle-preserve test marked flaky until helper PR lands.

mina: Thanks everyone — landing the sampleapp change now and will follow up with PR link and reproducer trace.
